topic: Orca versus great white shark compared
title: Orca vs Great White Shark: Who Rules the Sea?
description:
Orcas and great white sharks are both apex predators, but off South Africa the orcas have been seen hunting sharks. Here is the comparison.

#orca #greatwhiteshark #animals #shorts

scenes.narration: Which is the real king of the ocean, the orca or the great white shark?

visual.prompt: an orca and a great white shark swimming toward each other in deep blue water, cinematic wide shot

scenes.narration: An adult male orca can reach about eight meters and several tons, far bigger than a typical great white of four to five meters.

visual.prompt: a huge male orca with a tall dorsal fin surfacing beside a small boat for scale, daylight

scenes.narration: The great white has powerful jaws and sharp serrated teeth, an ambush hunter that strikes from below.

visual.prompt: a great white shark rising from the deep with open jaws toward the camera, dramatic light

scenes.narration: But orcas hunt in family groups, talk with sound, and plan together, a huge advantage in a fight.

visual.prompt: a pod of orcas swimming in formation near the surface of a calm sea, aerial view

scenes.narration: Off South Africa, orcas have been documented killing great whites, and sharks have fled the area after orcas showed up.

visual.prompt: a lone great white shark swimming away over a sandy seabed with kelp, moody light

scenes.narration: Attack score: orca nine, shark eight. Defense score: orca eight, shark only four.

visual.prompt: an orca breaching the water surface with spray, powerful pose, golden hour

scenes.narration: The orca wins on brains and teamwork. Do you agree, or would you back the shark? Tell us in the comments.

visual.prompt: an orca dorsal fin cutting through calm water at sunset, silhouette
